DATA & DELETION

Your data. Your say.

This page concerns Face Watch Face and its website preview.

The website preview

The preview does not create accounts or save your selections. Closing or refreshing the page clears the current artwork selection. There is no website profile to delete.

Data on your watch

Review your watch’s app and permission settings to manage access to sensors and other data. Uninstalling an app may remove local app data, but it does not necessarily delete cloud data, store purchase records, or information held by a third-party provider.

Account and app-data deletion requests

Deletion contact pending.

The app’s account system, data retention, and verified support address have not yet been confirmed. This page is not an operational app-account deletion request channel. A verified contact or working request flow must be added if the app creates accounts or retains user data.

If you already use the app, check its settings and the developer contact on its official store listing for available deletion options. A deletion request should identify Face Watch Face and the relevant account without including your password.

What the final policy will explain

The completed app policy will identify what is deleted, any data retained and why, retention periods, and how to request deletion. See the privacy policy for the current scope.
